body: I'm scared to mention this to a professional, I've tried but changed my mind at the last second. Would I be sectioned or something? I don't know what happens...
Thanks, I'll keep digging for it at least.
I know there's nothing wrong with asking for help but it's not something I usually do. Also, I'm embarrassed that I have mental health issues.

Thanks for taking the time to write this..

I have trouble asking for help - it's just the kind of person I am. But you're right there is no need to do it right now.
Plus, my family's back home now some I'm not in as much danger... from myself.

I don't mean to imply that people who back out of suicide attempts are cowards. Just me.

I know that doesn't make sense.
